tasks.label: Generate launch.env
tasks.command: TOP=ardour; . $TOP/build/gtk2_ardour/ardev_common_waf.sh; export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u); export PIPEWIRE_RUNTIME_DIR=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; export PULSE_SERVER=unix:$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pipewire-0.3/jack:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH; export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pipewire-0.3/jack/libjack.so.0${LD_PRELOAD:+:$LD_PRELOAD}; UBUNTU_MENUPROXY=''; ARDOUR_INSIDE_GDB=1; printenv > launch.env
